questions.question: Does EdCoach AI replace our formal evaluation system?
questions.answer: No, EdCoach AI is designed to supplement—not replace—your formal evaluation process. It streamlines informal feedback and growth between formal observations.

questions.question: How do teachers access their feedback?
questions.answer: Teachers have a secure portal to view all feedback interactions in a clear, organized feed.

questions.question: How secure is our school's data?
questions.answer: Extremely. We use industry-leading partners (Convex & Clerk) for encrypted storage, secure authentication (MFA available), and adhere to strict data privacy protocols designed for education.

questions.question: How does role-based access work?
questions.answer: Principals, coaches, and teachers each have access to the features and data relevant to their role, ensuring privacy and clarity for everyone.

questions.question: What are the usage limits for each plan?
questions.answer: Each plan has clear limits on the number of teachers you can support and walkthroughs you can complete per month. Upgrade prompts and usage tracking help you stay on top of your plan.

questions.question: How does EdCoach AI ensure feedback is rubric-aligned?
questions.answer: Our AI is trained on the Louisiana Educator Rubric (LER), LEADS, and NIET frameworks, ensuring all feedback is aligned to your district's standards and best practices.

questions.question: How fast is feedback generated?
questions.answer: Feedback is generated in real time—usually within a few seconds—so you can deliver actionable insights immediately after each walkthrough.

questions.question: How long is my data retained?
questions.answer: Analytics and feedback are retained for 30 days on the Starter plan and 90 days on the Pro plan, helping you track growth over time.

questions.question: What advanced features are available in the Pro plan?
questions.answer: Coach Pro includes bulk teacher invitations, advanced analytics, feedback export as PDF, and priority support.
